variables.name: MODE_MASK
variables.description: Octal mask of permission bits that must be clear on control-plane and kubelet files. 077 means no group or other access.

variables.name: ANONYMOUS_AUTH
variables.description: Required anonymous-auth value for the API server and kubelet.

variables.name: PROFILING
variables.description: Required --profiling value for the API server, controller-manager, and scheduler.

variables.name: AUDIT_LOG_MAXAGE
variables.description: Minimum audit-log-maxage in days.

variables.name: AUDIT_LOG_MAXBACKUP
variables.description: Minimum audit-log-maxbackup.

variables.name: AUDIT_LOG_MAXSIZE
variables.description: Minimum audit-log-maxsize in megabytes.

variables.name: STRONG_TLS
variables.default: TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305 TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384 TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305 TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384 TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384 TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256 TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256
variables.description: Space-separated cipher suites treated as strong for the API server and kubelet.

variables.name: POD_GC_MIN
variables.description: Minimum terminated-pod-gc-threshold.

variables.name: SA_CREDENTIALS
variables.description: Required use-service-account-credentials value.

variables.name: BIND_ADDRESS
variables.description: Required bind-address for the controller-manager and scheduler.

variables.name: ETCD_CLIENT_CERT_AUTH
variables.description: Required etcd client-cert-auth value.

variables.name: ETCD_PEER_CERT_AUTH
variables.description: Required etcd peer-client-cert-auth value.

variables.name: SA_BINDING_MAX
variables.description: ServiceAccount ClusterRoleBinding count above this fails the check.

variables.name: READONLY_PORT
variables.description: Required kubelet readOnlyPort. An unset port still passes when this is 0.

variables.name: POD_PIDS_MIN
variables.description: Minimum kubelet podPidsLimit. Remediation writes 1024 unless this minimum is higher.

variables.name: SECRETS_RBAC_MAX
variables.description: Non-system roles that can read secrets above this count fail the check.

variables.name: WILDCARD_RBAC_MAX
variables.description: Custom wildcard RBAC roles above this count fail the check.

variables.name: POD_CREATE_MAX
variables.description: Non-system roles that can create pods above this count fail the check.

variables.name: BIND_RBAC_MAX
variables.description: Custom bind/impersonate/escalate roles above this count fail the check.

variables.name: WEBHOOK_RBAC_MAX
variables.description: Custom roles that can change webhook configuration above this count fail the check.

variables.name: NAMESPACE_MIN
variables.description: Namespace count must be greater than this.
